intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Auburn for 2026, and here is what he found: 10 family events, 4 of them free. New in this update: Festival of Trees at White River Valley Museum (from November 25), Mini Makers: Gingerbread House Workshop at Les Gove (December 4) and Holiday Workshops at Postmark Center for the Arts (from December 5). We check every date on the host’s own website or an official city calendar, and each listing links straight there. For the rest of the state, see our Washington Christmas events for kids guide.

Planning a bigger day out? Auburn families also use our guide to Christmas events for kids in Seattle, which covers Seattle Center Winterfest, WildLanterns, the North Pole Limited Santa train and more.

What Rally found in Auburn

  • 10 Christmas events for kids in Auburn
  • 4 free to attend
  • Also on the list: 2 shows and 5 craft or cookie events
  • New events in this update run November 25 to January 3
  • Every date checked on the host’s own site or an official city calendar on Nov 26
